question: Justice Sanjiv Khanna took over as the _____ Chief Justice of India on 11 November 2024.
solution:
The correct answer is __**51st**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Justice Sanjiv Khanna took over as the **51st Chief Justice of India** on 11 November 2024.
 
• He succeeded Justice Dhananjaya Y. Chandrachud as the Chief Justice of India.
 
• The Chief Justice of India is the head of the judiciary in India and the Supreme Court of India.
 
• Justice Sanjiv Khanna was appointed by the President of India following the recommendation of the collegium of judges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Role of Chief Justice of India**

 
 
• The Chief Justice of India is responsible for the allocation of cases and appointment of constitutional benches.
 
• The CJI also plays a crucial role in judicial appointments and administrative functions of the court.
 
 
 
• **Supreme Court of India**
 
 
• It is the highest judicial forum and final court of appeal in India.
 
• It was established on January 28, 1950, under the Constitution of India.
 
• The Supreme Court comprises the Chief Justice of India and a maximum of 34 judges.
 
 
 
• **Judicial Appointments in India**
 
 
• Judges of the Supreme Court are appointed by the President of India.
 
• The collegium system, which includes the Chief Justice of India and four senior-most judges, recommends appointments and transfers of judges.
 
• Appointments are made based on seniority and merit.
 
 
 
• **Collegium System**
 
 
• It is a system of appointment and transfer of judges that has evolved through judgments of the Supreme Court.
 
• The collegium is headed by the Chief Justice of India and includes the four senior-most judges of the Supreme Court.
 
• It plays a significant role in maintaining the independence of the judiciary.
